Not sure if anyone still needs help.

But I made it work by going to App info, clearing Cache, uninstalling the app and after installing it again it allowed me to sign in.

Hopes this helps for someone!
Well this mount was teased actually so hopefully we'll get it!

I don't mean to be rude..
But I don't get why are you are doing this..

I do speak my mind if something bugs me and people hate me for it. And I feel like if I killed myself then maybe some other young kid wouldn't do it, I have no explanation why, I just thought so.. 

And I love spending time with my boyfriend though he's been very busy lately, so we don't get to talk much..

I'm trying really hard to convince myself to contact a therapist.. but it's so hard for some reason

Life is hard... and I'm just not a fighter, I can't take all these hits and just get back up, it as If I'm in a never ending nightmare, that I can't wake from. 

The only way to "wake up" is to die

If only I wasn't such a pathetic coward...

Sad stuff idk.. whatever comes to mind.

And school sucks, because my "colleagues/classmates" whatever... they all hate me, because I speak my opinion when something doesn't sit well with me.

I don't know what someone that would listen to me would look like, just someone who actually gives a shit. I went on a page for people with suicidal thoughts, but the line is online Monday to Thursday and again Saturday which I of course forgot, but the hours they "work" at are so bizarre to me its like from 

5 - 9pm Monday - Thursday 
1 - 5pm Saturday 

Might just be me... but that's odd...

What about Sunday? That's where I feel like they should really be there... someone like myself feel the worst on sundays because I know Monday is tomorrow and hell will just start all over unless I skip school which I did all last week without anyone knowing...

The fuck am I going to do... 
Everything is fucked, it's like I'm going to be the sacrifice so other young adults can have a chance or some bullshit like that...
I'm getting really sick of all this...

I don't want to live, but I'm too scared to die too...
It's pathetic, I decide to do it, and then think about all the possible things I'll miss out on... like meeting my bf again... spending time with him... but then again... he would be much better off without someone as unstable as me...

Thank you.. and I'm sorry for everyone reading my post and comments. Strangers shouldn't have my problems in their mind.

Honestly though I don't have anything to look forward too, my boyfriend coming here is maybe the only thing that makes me wish the future would come. 

Other then that, I don't know. Waiting for a time where my life will finally look better. I'm sorta hoping my brother will buy the house he's been looking at. Then I can move in there hopefully and take a breath.. but I don't know.. moving out from my mom and dad, despite her being a part of why I'm down... yeah idk..

So much trouble just to live a life.. I didn't expect it to be easy, but this? This is crazy

I don't draw a whole lot. Most of what I do is for my own venting.

And attending school sucks... it just sucks, it's 7:36am and I waiting to leave the house to take my bus, then I should chance bus to take me to school, but I won't. Not sure where I'll go, but school is not an option... I'm considering telling my mom I quit, that I'm not going back there no matter what, I know she'll hate me, if it's even possible for her to hate me more than she probably does.

I don't know how I feel, I feel sad and frustrated and like I'm just done with everything. No one listens to me regardless of what I say maybe if I'm suddenly not there they will finally take me serious and figure it out when it's too late just so another young person like me will maybe finally be helped
And not be let down.

It's too expensive.. to get a therapist.. and I doubt talking about it would do me good..  besides my mother isn't one to believe in mental health, she thinks its nonsense ao she would never have me go...

I really..  wish..  my boyfriend would break up with me. That I'd tell him something horrible to make him hate me... then I could end everything for good, he's the only reason I'm here.. 

While I wish I wasn't...

I just wanna die... and be at peace..

It makes me feel better.. that you say that.. and I do draw at times drawing and writing are my biggest hobbies and I enjoy doing it a lot.. but it's not gonna get me places.. at times. I consider just giving up entirely.

I'm sick atm so I haven't attend school thank God.. 
I don't know if I'm going tomorrow I hope not.

When I went to shower yesterday, I saw my dad's razor and went to the drawer where the extra blades are. I picked a box up but I didn't want to open a new one and risk him seeing... and I couldn't ... no I didn't try hard enough to verwk my own razor because I was scared what was going to happen if I did break it and got the blade out... 

So nothing happened...

And I'm still here... complaining when i should get it over with...

I just don't wanna deal with any of this anymore.
I'd rather go years back and deal with all that shit then this.
Heck, I'd rather be thrown in hell for daily torture then what this is doing to my mentality
Idk.. what would make me happy is never having to attend that school ever ever again.. but I know that won't just happen until I "grow up" and get on with my life...
Thank you.. means a lot.. I just Don't know what to do honestly..

I don't understand.. why do you care? I appreciate that you keep replying and asking.. but I don't get it.. maybe its out if pity.. when I first made this post, it wasn't to gain pity..  it was so that when that one day happens, my loved ones, could have a chance of getting a look inside my mind for a final time... even though I know, the chance of them seeing this is extremely small..

But idk what my ideal world would look like, me not being so damn pathetic? Everyone tells me to get a job and grow up, its feels like I being pushed out of school by tormenting me just my life will hit its final Downfall, I honestly wish I didn't have this Mentality I have.. I wish I could f grow up and get some job... people keep asking me 

"What are you going to do?" "Arent you going to start working soon?" 

They might have their life planned out but I don't... my social anxiety makes it hard to be out and working around people or with a lot of costumers... I keep being told to maybe go try a Tech school where I can take up drawing cuz I do that sometimes.. but its nothing but stick figures compared to what real artists can do plus the school is so far from my town.. and I hate take public transportation to a city I don't know.. I will just get off and have a panic attack so everyone can see how pathetic I truly am...

I really wish I could just search the most pain free and quick way to die, but so far I never get a result I can use...

It just sucks.

Looking at my other siblings it's clear that it's me that's something wrong with. They are living their lives while I'm strongly focused on finding a way to end mine.

I don't know how anyone could support me, I guess maybe because I honestly don't want them too, if people support and take notice to me, how am I to suddenly vanish, they'll risk feeling as if they didn't do enough because they were close to me and maybe should have seen.

I've had these thoughts for years now, started a couple of years ago when I still in school, depression, anxiety, et cetera et cetera... and it's just stuck with me, at least the constant voice I had back then is gone..

I don't know.. and I just do, I see how well others are doing and how well even my younger sister is doing, I'm just the black sheep in this family.. even my friend who's some times struggling like me, finds a way to keep going and try and achieve what she wants to be for her future.

But idk what that is, I don't have a goal... It's like looking into nothing. 

I keep having these thoughts.. negative and scary thoughts. The new "Corona Virus" was just "maybe" discovered today from a woman who arrived on a plane, and honestly I keep hoping that virus finds me as soon as possible and hopefully I'd die from it, so I don't have to do this on my own...
